correctness.rationale: The repaired theorem is exactly the order-eight census, under vertex deletion, uniform remaining seed, independent homogeneous edges and a mean including the seed. Unique paths give probability p^j for each connected ordered pair of distance j, hence mean 1+W_v/7. The coefficient test transforms each competitor difference by p=t/(1+t) and multiplies by (1+t)^6; nonnegative coefficients prove the inequality for all t>0, while failure by itself proves nothing. Independently `python3 /workspace/audit-work/small_graphs.py` generates unlabelled types by attaching a leaf at every possible vertex and taking the least rooted canonical encoding over all roots, a complete invariant. Every tree has a leaf, so no class is lost. The independent path-enumeration routine increments counts for every deleted vertex outside each path, in contrast to the frozen checker’s separate post-deletion searches. It gives 23 types and 21 universal certificates, and verifies disjoint optimizer sets at 1/2 and 9/10 for the exact two exceptional shapes. The explicit competitor differences in the repaired RESULT are strictly positive in the open interval and agree with these independently computed polynomials. The remaining differences 2p(1−p²−p³) and 2p(1−2p²) yield the stated minimizing sets on either side and at equality. No inference about larger trees or real contact networks is made; the frozen package checker was inspected, not executed.

evidence: The 639f57a81324 study covers every tree through seven, uses the same eight-vertex spider witness, and supplies analogous spiders at all larger orders. Its Verification explicitly enumerates all Prüfer words through seven only and gives profiles for the eight vaccination vertices of one order-eight witness.

The broom family statement includes the treated broom at parameters k=2 and L=5, not the two-branch double-broom. The related edge-cut census changes an edge and retains all possible seeds, not deleting a vertex and choosing among the remaining ones.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Broader order along a restricted spider family does not dominate a full order-eight census. In particular, removing a degree-three vaccination vertex can produce three components and changes the sample space; it is not the same operation as cutting a single edge.

evidence: The distance-polynomial identity and coefficient transform already appear in the strongest Resultary antecedent. Its bounded certificate covers all small trees only through seven and treats one longer witness.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The old identity makes the new finite calculation possible but does not give the exhaustive exclusion of the other 21 shapes or the strict double-broom optimum. Those require checking all candidates and the sign switch; neither follows from the established first-onset witness.

evidence: In record 639f57a81324 the spider with arms (1,1,5) is the repaired theorem’s broom: one degree-three vertex joined to two leaves and to a path of length five. Its switch polynomial matches exactly. The double-broom has two vertices of degree three and is not a spider with one branching vertex.
For the same seed convention Holme’s continuous-time Markov SIR has the same mean objective on trees after parameter matching, since the transmitters on a path are distinct.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The old witness is not distinct under relabelling or the epidemic/percolation reformulation. The mean correspondence makes the low-order Holme comparison material, but its enumeration through seven does not cover the order-eight census.

originality.rationale: The frozen finding’s threshold through seven and its broom witness are demonstrably covered; they cannot pass as a new onset theorem. The repaired RESULT explicitly gives that credit and isolates the complete census at order eight, including the second exception, its threshold and optimizer sets. The strongest comparison found does not cover that remainder. This PASS is for the repaired claim only.
residual_risks: No claim of historical priority; equivalent unindexed enumerations may exist. Full text of the named site-bond paper was not read.

value.rationale: Order eight is fixed by the already established sharp first-onset theorem, rather than chosen as an arbitrary small test. A complete census at that natural boundary decides how exceptional the phenomenon is and exposes a second, structurally different switch between symmetric vertex pairs at a different critical value. Future work on switching families can use the exact two benchmark types and their optimizing sets. This does not rely on recrediting the known first-order cutoff or claiming applied epidemiological generality.
